def block(fr):
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        bs=n['boundary']; rs=[x[0] for x in bs]; cs=[x[1] for x in bs]
        if 20<=n['pixels']<=120 and not (33<=min(rs) and max(rs)<=44 and 26<=min(cs) and max(cs)<=37) and not (min(rs)<15 and min(cs)<15):
            return n['color'], min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
print('block after select:', block(current_frame))
res=action([{'action':'SPACE'}])
print('result:', {k:last_action_result.get(k) for k in ('board_changed','done','level_completed','game_over','run_complete','reward')})
def sq(fr):
    A=fr.ascii.split('\n')
    return ''.join(''.join(A[r][c] for c in range(27,37)) for r in range(34,44))
print('square now:', sq(current_frame).replace('p','.').replace('W','#').replace('O','o'))
print('level:', current_frame.level, 'step:', current_frame.step)
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
